blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: Ferd Ray is an insufferable, unstoppable, and most importantly a stubborn mindless maniac who will do anything for the people he loves, and whatever he wants for himself of course. He has a very inflated ego... Not when he's around with his girlfriend, then he turns into a complete submissive dork. Originating from a rather normal variation of 'Earth', as a young adult he and the love of his life Ena Lone chose to enlist in the military seemingly for easy money, which obviously, escalated into... a trap, would that even be the right word to describe it? They both dearly love their time working as expendable pawns for the Disobedient Armed Forces.

He has short white fur with black marks around his left eye, ears, and hips. His legs are thicker than usual for his size, but the rest of his body is perfectly average. His pupils have a strange white glow, and his blood is one of an extraordinarily rare type. His body is a perfect canvas for fashion, unfortunately he lacks a sense for that.

Surprisingly, he doesn't want to return to the place where he came from. He claims he found his life together with Ena Lone, fighting in an endless unreasonable war forever deep in outer space. It doesn't matter if they've lived together through missions for years; one day, one of them will lose another, and their baffling view of conquest as a game will shatter completely.

blockTwo.heading: Trivia From A Place Above
listItems: He was originally based off a friend's pet cat named Jasper, having violet fur, lighter marks, and dotted eyes.
When I first added the glasses to his character he was supposed to have them on the eyes all the time, it looked a little too cool for him so I changed that.
Owning and riding a motorcycle was supposed to be an iconic part of his character, but I couldn't think of any plausible scenarios when writing that would also fit his character I had in mind.

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: Ena Lone is a hotheaded dominant force. Incredibly popular among peers, though not so much outside of the city where she came from. Often thinks she's at the top of the world, leaves no space for others' opinions and if anyone even dares to disagree with her they will quickly be in a world of hurt. Originating from a rather normal variation of 'Earth', as a young adult she and the love of her life Ferd Ray chose to enlist in the military seemingly for easy money after her dream of becoming a popular musician failed, which obviously, escalated into... a trap, would that even be the right word to describe it? They both dearly love their time working as expendable pawns for the Disobedient Armed Forces.

Quite uncommon in the place where she comes from, she has no fur. Her skin is plain white and very soft, and interestingly enough her body lacks marks for a giant panda. At around the age of four she was found and adopted by the known pink Lone panda family, and she quickly grew up with pink-shaded makeup and hair dyes just to fit in. She was found with a pretty severe birthmark on her right eye, she hides it with her hair because not only does it look pretty ugly she also claims it's hard to see with it anyway. Enjoys ponytails, interested in fashion, but likes to keep things simple and dresses pretty plainly. Has a freaky pierced tongue.

blockTwo.heading: Trivia From A Place Above
listItems: She was quite popular for a moment, her being the first fuzzy character I have created has led me to draw her a lot.
Her design somehow stems from the Fortnite skin Skull Squad Leader. She went through an entire evolution of designs, which inspired some insane lore and characters. What?
The web series Madness Combat heavily influenced her old stories, to this day I'm not really sure what was up with that either.

blockOne.Sources: Celebrity Highlights For Total Dweebs Vol. 97, New Babylon: Interesting Figures Part 39. Shortened for the reader's convenience.

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: Niku Hazune is one of the most recognizable and unique idols in the universe, originally built to serve as an advanced animatronic in an assumed restaurant with a special voice. Her popularity swiftly took off once a popular artist specializing in experimental music sampled her voice for a whole album, and since then even more artists took note of her special voice which was barely ever heard anywhere else. She somehow managed to change the perception of Vocaloids in the universe, turning an otherwise niche type of music into something much greater. It is completely unclear on what is going on with her behind the scenes, but her first live appearance took place at Festival of Life: Power & Love where her popularity really soared with an original track composed with the help of anonymous producers and Nayami Yuko. Her voice is so angelic that many refuse to believe she is an android in the first place.

She has silky smooth white fur paired with turquoise hair styled with iconic long twin ponytails. Her ears are usually droopy for convenience. Favors a light blue color, her outfits are usually centered around it. Deep inside she knows she's nothing but wires and technology and it hurts for her to admit, but it doesn't stop her from creating more and inspiring artists all over the universe.

Hazune Niku is a name that's basically become embedded as THE Vocaloid. She works with any and all genres, for any and all audiences and haters. Her immense, somewhat controversial talent also painted her as a great target, she could do what no other android could. During the year 2761, she was stolen by CREATECH to be completely reprogrammed and perform for their company, rather than being a freelancer open to collaborate with popular names. During the same year, just a month later, three underground artists set on an illegal and dangerous operation to save her. Everyone thought they were taking a break simultaneously. They described the whole ordeal as wild upon returning, claiming they would gladly kick ass for Hazune Niku again.

blockTwo.heading: Trivia From A Place Above
listItems: She was originally made to test the character page for this website.
And I thought it'd be a funny parody.

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: This guy fucking GAMES. Also very racist as it comes with the hardcore gaming. Commonly confused with another user online called Qwerturdle. When it's not racist, it is pretty chill. He is a big green tortoise, his eyes are permanently closed. He has a (usually) RGB keyboard on top of his shell, missing a toe nail on one of his feet, big green tail, and (ski band) headphones. Racist, not sexist though, and chill sometimes but gets angry easily. He takes small things pretty seriously. His favorite games are Text of Responsibility, Oxidation, and Opposite Hit 2. He got serpentine in Voice of Duty, met Sonchai Anong, died, then didn't.

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: Emma is a leader of one of the seven towns of the fourth continent in Odyssey-812, one which is named simply just 'Johnny'. She is a fierce fighter, powerful, commanding, assign her as the leader to any workplace and you'd come back to sweet efficiency. Such corporate life isn't for her however, she strives in nature, hunting animals and foraging plants of any kind for her town to grow and survive. She claims her last name is supposed to echo the religion she believes in, one that is surprisingly not well-known and widespread in the universe. Locals say no one has ever seen her outside during night, not even since she was a little kid. She is not exactly smart, but she is full of energy and life, which is why everyone loves her.

blockTwo.heading: Trivia

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: Tina is an incredibly ambitious and extroverted bear who always loves trying her hardest on even the most pointless activities. She is very reckless and confident and just loves being herself. Her energy makes her slightly annoying to some people. Aside from her high energy, she admires all of her friends and loves talking about her adventures and hobbies with them.

She was born with wealthy tech executives parents who want Tina to be perfect to be the next CEO. She was forced to study in the most pristine private schools and attend every important meeting in her company. This lasted until she went to college and finally got a taste of what it's like to be her true self. She met Maria in college, a lovely person who changed her whole life.

She has silky soft dark brown fur and long straight blonde hair. She has a very curvy body and constantly wears somewhat revealing and comfortable clothes that many around are often uncomfortable with.

blockTwo.heading: Trivia
listItems: Inspired by friends' other bear characters.
She lives in an old modified van she calls “Mina”.
She's so generic she doesn't have any other fun facts.

blockTwo.heading: General Information
paragraphs: Dennis is a very large and very relaxed cat born in a Sweden-like country who lives alone and loves eating pizza while watching tv and listening to music. He works a crappy minimum wage job at a supermarket that barely makes him pay the bills, however, a good amount of his income comes from selling a “stronger catnip”. Somehow, he makes lots of sales across European and American-like continents using cryptocurrency.

He is a very secretive person, constantly staying away from contact from anyone aside from his friends. Despite being very antisocial and somewhat intimidating, deep inside he is a soft gentle giant who always cares for his friends. He has a simple sense of fashion, though he barely washes the clothes he wears except for the ones signed by his favorite musicians.

blockTwo.heading: Trivia

He was made to celebrate cat day.
